mods.name: Legacy Resources
mods.description: Lets legacy 1.6-1.12 resource packs load in modern Minecraft by converting their textures, models and blockstates on the fly.

releases.notes:
Legacy Resources 1.1.0 adds more textures derived from each legacy pack's own artwork and fixes several rendering and animation issues.

**Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Java 25+, and Fabric API.**

### Install
Replace your existing Legacy Resources jar in `mods/` with `legacy-resources-1.1.0.jar`, then enable your legacy resource pack.

### Changes
- Add rooted dirt, deepslate masonry, magma block, and blackstone texture derivations.
- Convert legacy particle sheets into modern named particle sprites.
- Correct sign texture UV mapping and derive wood-specific signs and sign editor textures.
- Fix legacy animated texture frame sizes, derived entity animation frames, and dragon fireball animation.
- Correct legacy item transforms when held in the offhand.
- Restore potion bottle and overlay layers so only the potion contents receive the potion tint.
- Correct leather horse armor's base and overlay layers so dye tint applies once.
- Improve legacy beacon beam textures.

### Validation
The Minecraft model loaders passed across 75 converted packs, including vanilla 1.8.9: 1,068 blockstates, 338,609 models, and 35,218 item definitions. Targeted regression, chest, particle, item-transform, model-alias, and synthetic entity-oracle checks also passed.

### Known issue
The entity compatibility check still reports an unresolved beacon-beam texture in Absolute [16x]. This also occurs in the pre-merge code.

mods.description: Lets legacy 1.6-1.12 resource packs load in modern Minecraft by converting their textures, models and blockstates on the fly.

releases.notes:
First public release. Lets 1.6-1.12 resource packs load in modern Minecraft by converting textures, models and blockstates on the fly.

**Targets Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Java 25+, Fabric API).

### Install
Drop `legacy-resources-1.0.0.jar` into `mods/`, then enable a legacy pack in your resource pack list.

### What's in it
- Texture derivations ported to 26.3: crimson/warped nylium and wood, mangrove trees, stripped logs, deepslate and copper ores, soul fire and torch variants, animated texture support, wood fence texture bindings.
- Legacy item model transforms fixed to use 1.8.9's own models.
- Classic entity rendering: horses (armor + markings), pigs (saddles), sheep (wool), cats, rabbits.
- Chest and other blockstate conversions verified against PureBDcraft and vanilla 1.8.9's own tree.

### 26.2 → 26.3
26.3 splits pack loading into a metadata probe plus a stream of resource layers. Legacy detection moved onto the probe, since a converted pack deliberately reports the running `pack_format` and would otherwise never be detected as legacy. The lab drives the same path the game does, so its pack corpus exercises identical code.
